watch.summary: The streamer tells his egg to behave as it rolls down a physics obstacle course, only for it to fall to the ground and crack open.

beats.what: Streamer tells the egg to behave itself as it rolls along a narrow wooden track.
The egg bounces through a tire and drops off the platform.
The egg lands in the grass and cracks open.
Streamer watches in stunned silence before quietly chuckling.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The contrast between the streamer pleading with the egg to behave and its instant destruction makes for a classic mini-fail beat. His silent, deadpan reaction gives the quick clip a smooth punchline.
